column1: Kubernetes supported minors (Nov 2026) and the next release
How long a Kubernetes minor is patched, precisely
column2: About 12 months of support plus 2 months of maintenance mode, so ~14 months: 1.37 released 2026-08-26, maintenance mode 2027-08-28, EOL 2027-10-28 (L45, L67)

column1: kubelet skew with the apiserver at 1.37
column2: kubelet 1.34 to 1.37 (never newer, up to three older). In-place minor kubelet upgrades are not supported: drain and replace the node (L45, L67)

column1: Features earlier lessons called beta that are now GA
column2: ImageVolume GA in 1.36; MutatingAdmissionPolicy GA in 1.36; HPA configurable tolerance GA in 1.37 (it was beta but OFF by default in 1.35-1.36) (L27, L28, L67)
Upstream maintenance ended March 2026; CVE-2026-116472 (mirror-target self-DoS) will not be fixed upstream. Plan the move to a Gateway API controller (L57, L67)
StatefulSet controller confused deputy: write on StatefulSet + ControllerRevision lets you create a pod in another namespace. Fixed in kube-controller-manager 1.34.12 / 1.35.9 / 1.36.5 / 1.37.1 (L67)
CVE-2026-24260, TOCTOU, CVSS 8.5 (June 2026 bulletin): Toolkit up to 1.19.0 fixed in 1.19.1; GPU Operator up to 26.3.1 fixed in 26.3.2 (L64, L67)

runc CVE-2026-119101 (restore bind-mounts a host dir read-write; fixed 1.5.3 / 1.4.4), crun CVE-2026-115520, CRIU CVE-2026-119614, containerd CRI CVE-2026-95837 (critical; restored process keeps checkpoint privileges; fixed 2.2.7 / 2.3.4). Kubelet ContainerCheckpoint is beta and on by default since 1.30 (L67)
CVE-2026-115912: a forged multimodal shared-memory handle reaches worker-side pickle.loads() in scale-out deployments with the SHM multimodal cache; fixed in 0.32.0 (L64, L67)

MCP spec release 2026-07-28; A2A v1.0.0 (2026-03-12, breaking changes; latest v1.0.1); Kubernetes agent-sandbox v1.0.x (v1.0.11 on 2026-11-12) (L52, L54, L67)
Desired retention defaults to 90%; optimize parameters about monthly; a card becomes a leech at 8 lapses (tagged and suspended), then warnings every 4 more (L67)

column1: How to stay current between loops
column2: I run a quarterly fact audit: every version, CVE and GPU name in my notes is checked against the upstream source, and anything I can't verify comes off the card. (L67)
